name: intraday-equities-multi3-h01-lgbm
notes: LightGBM on all five tradables (AAPL, JPM, LLY, WMT, XOM; AAPL and WMT are back - the split-adjusted store, read from 2018-01-01, removed the unadjusted splits that excluded them, ADR-0063 and ADR-0066, so every number this document produces supersedes the three-name results recorded before 2026-09-03), with the ADR-0059 label: residual to SPY, then divided by its own causal 390-minute sigma times sqrt(h). Both transforms answer A0040: squared loss on a raw return weights the open hour 5-10x the midday, and at 5-20 minutes most of a single name's variance is the market move the features cannot forecast. MSPE is now in LABEL units and is NOT comparable with any raw-label run; val_ic stays rank-based and is. Paired with run-multi3-h20-ridge.json, which differs ONLY in the scan node's estimator block (ADR-0060). hpo_trials stays 6, not the 32 of A0036: that search ranked 32 tree combos on an inner holdout whose score carried no information about fold validation, so the draws bought noise. Six draws over four knobs is a floor, not a search. HORIZON: this document asks about H=1 minute(s) ONLY - lead_start=lead_stop=1 (ADR-0062), so the training label and the single walked lead are both 1. The H=20 family trained at 5 and walked 5/10/15/20; these are a different question on the same cohort, folds and label, not a re-run.

universe.notes: The H<=20 grid variant. lead_start=5 is also the training label.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted historical SIP tape (source alpaca-sip-split, ADR-0063): AAPL's 2020 4-for-1, WMT's 2024 3-for-1 and the XLE/XLK 2-for-1s of December 2025 are all removed by the vendor, so no change of unit reads as a price move. start_ms is the study's start date, 2018-01-01 (ADR-0066) - it precedes the earliest bar any fold reads by 2y4m, and it puts XLF's 2016-09-19 XLRE spin-off, the one corporate action the vendor does NOT adjust, outside the readable window. Prices here are NOT the as-traded scale and are not comparable with any number recorded before 2026-09-03. Run from the child root.

session.notes: Regular session only; the store keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom. cross_session so its warmup is once, not daily.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session. cross_session so its warmup is once, not daily.
Five RTH sessions, about a week.

features.notes: lookback=20 emits one-minute ret_lag columns for the last 20 minutes. Every horizon here is cross_session so none costs rows beyond a one-time warmup; see docs/research/row-loss-is-intra-session-scale-warmup-not-cross-session.md.

tradable.notes: SPY has already entered the residual features; score tradables.

scan.notes: LightGBM with the symbol as a category, six inner-holdout draws over four knobs. Same label, same folds, same cohort as the ridge twin: the estimator block is the ONLY difference, so a gap between them is the model and nothing else. The grid is the single lead 1: h* is 1 or nothing, and the Clark-West p IS the test at that horizon.

names.notes: All five tradables. AAPL and WMT were excluded while the tape carried unadjusted splits; the split-adjusted store (ADR-0063) removed that reason, so the cohort that builds the features and the cohort that gets SCORED are the same five again. Sits after tradable so a later run can narrow what is scored without touching what is built.

walkforward.notes: Same post-COVID folds as run-hstar-cv-postcovid.json so the two are comparable: first validation 2022-05-06, twenty 63-day steps, a real 730-day bounded training window, last validation inside the 2025-11-30 cut. objective is val_ic, NOT go_frac: counting fold-level rejections and taking the max is vote counting, which Hedges-Olkin showed is inconsistent when per-fold power is below one half (A0035). The winner here only labels a fold in the summary; the science is the per-fold sequence, which is what the block-by-block reading needs. embargo_days=5 is now larger than any label window on this grid (20 minutes), so no training row's label can reach into validation.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.
